entries.clue: Night of 31 October when the dead were said to walk abroad.
Wailing woman of Irish legend whose cry means a death is coming.
Rubber blade dragged down a soapy window pane
Filmy white emanation of the darkened seance room, often exposed as cheesecloth.

Red-wine mark that survives three trips through the machine

Resinous gum set alight so its fragrant smoke drifts through a temple.
